purpose: Describe being covered or soiled with an unwanted substance.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
My shoes became covered in mud.
The work clothes are covered in oil.
The old box was covered in dust.
restrictions: Usually with mud, blood, sweat, dust, or analogous contamination.
mistake: For pleasant coverage, まみれ is usually unsuitable.
